note: Miria stammers the name in two pieces, as the source splits it.

en: Soara
"Ah... uh-uh-uh..."{w}
"S-Soaraaa...!!"{w}
"...Wh-what?"{w}
"'What'...?{w}We're seeing each other for the first time in years, and all you can say is 'what'!?"{w}
"Wh-what are you, an idiot!?{w}There's no reason to cry, is there!?"{w}
"Waaaaah!{w}Soara... Soara's come baaaack!!"{w}
"Honestly. You're the one who told me to get out, Miria."{w}
note: Refers to the flashback in 99162 (row 4053).

en: "I never thought you'd actually go!"{w}

"...I had a feeling it would come to this. Somehow, the adventurers at the Training Hall and I just weren't running at the same temperature..."{w}{p}"But leaving Bistel, where I'd lived so long, going somewhere without you or anyone I knew...{w}I was scared."{w}{p}"So, looking back on it... um... I think it gave me a good push."{w}
note: [JP] kept as a temperature image (different levels of zeal). [JP] = 'a good push', echoed by Miria in 3920.

en: "Here I was worried sick about you, and you call it 'a good push'...?{w}Soara, you big idiooot..."{w}
"*sniff*... How was Rubenburg...? Did you get to learn lots...?"{w}
"Yep, I became a genius!"{w}
"...You went one hair past genius and turned into an idiooot!"{w}
note: [JP] = the proverbial thin line between genius and idiot.

en: "I-I'm kidding!{w}But I studied hard and graduated top of my class.{w}Look, my diploma!!"{w}
"Th-that's amazing... Top of the class at that prestigious school!?"{w}

"Prestigious or not... it's nothing special.{w}I found that out once I got in."{w}{p}"Rubenburg was the same. If anything, since their livelihoods didn't depend on it, they were less serious than the people here."{w}
"Ahaha..."{w}

"You were right, Miria. Everyone has a different goal."{w}{p}"My friends there too -- instead of becoming court mages, some wanted to mix medicines and take over the family business, and all sorts of things."{w}{p}"Even if other people fall short in my eyes, they have goals of their own... and that isn't a matter of right or wrong."{w}
"So you finally get it!"{w}
"Well... something like that... I guess.{w}Actually, you know..."{w}
"Ooh, ooh, I know!{w}You said something you shouldn't have, and they picked on you! They put thumbtacks in your school slippers!!"{w}
note: [JP] = hand-raising 'Ooh, I know!'. [JP] = indoor school shoes.

en: "Ugh... What an old-fashioned idea...{w}...is what I'd like to say, but it was something like that.{w}Though I fought back with magic traps."{w}{p}"Honestly, it was appalling. Like, what did you people even come to school for?"{w}
note: [JP] not in glossary; rendered as the common noun 'magic traps'.

en: "No, but come on. If you were still the Soara you were that day, of course you'd be hard to get along with, right?"{w}
"At times like that... for some reason, the face that came to mind was yours, Miria."{w}
"If it was that hard on you... you could have just come to see me."{w}
"How could I have shown my face to you?{w}When I pictured your angry face, Miria, somehow it cheered me up, and I kept going...!"{w}
"Wait, not my smiling face!?"{w}

"Eventually I went a little too far, and I got called in by the Board Chair."{w}{p}"Not the Principal -- the Board Chair! I was so surprised."{w}{p}"And the Board Chair said,{w}'You have plenty of talent, but you're far too stubborn. You're the spitting image of me when I was young.'"{w}
note: [JP] = Board Chair, [JP] = Principal (glossary). Chair's words in [JP] -> single quotes.

en: "I know! And then it was 'I'll take you on as my apprentice' or something! That's how it goes, right!?"{w}
note: Phrased as a quote to avoid a pronoun for the Chair.

en: "No way!{w}I shot back, 'You don't even know me, so don't go deciding we're alike, you moron!'"{w}
note: [JP] kept at full rudeness.

en: "What were you thinking...? You had a mentor right there..."{w}
note: [JP] = 'the mentor you were lucky to get'.

en: "Then the Chair went, 'See, right there! That's just like me! Just like meee! Hyah hyah hyah!!' and was tickled pink about it! What an infuriating old geezer!"{w}
note: [JP] = old geezer, kept as in source; it is the only gender cue for the Chair. Source typo [JP] ignored.

en: "...Really, though, the Chair is a truly admirable person.{w}I want to be like the Board Chair. I feel like, for the first time, I've met someone I can respect."{w}
"And what was the Principal doing all that time?"{w}
"Oinking away."{w}
note: [JP] = pig noises (the Principal giggles [JP] elsewhere).

en: "Figures."{w}

"The Board Chair told me, 'Think of it as being tested.'"{w}{p}"I'm no saint. It's only natural to get angry when people pull nasty stuff on you, right?"{w}{p}"Even so, my power... this may sound arrogant, but it's stronger than an ordinary mage's."{w}{p}"Whether you can use that power 'for everyone's sake' without being swayed by your own feelings -- the Chair says a powerful mage is always being tested on that."{w}
"Then somehow we got to talking about my future, and when I said I wanted to be useful to everyone, I...{w}ended up getting a place at the Bistel Magic Bureau!"{w}
"Whaaaaat!?"{w}
"The Board Chair knows Director Archelon of the Bistel Magic Bureau, and wrote a letter for me. A recommendation, you know!!"{w}
note: [JP] rendered with the glossary title 'Director Archelon' ([JP] -> no gendered 'Lord').

en: "Th-that's amazing!"{w}

"I'm going to give it my all for this city."{w}{p}"First off, as a Magic Bureau officer, I'm supposed to travel around the city and the world and report back on the situation regularly.{w}So I'm thinking of coming back as an adventurer."{w}
"R-really!?"{w}
"Yep! Just for a limited time, though."{w}
"In that case...{w}slot 57 in the adventurer register is open, you know?"{w}
"Huh? Any number's fine, really...{w}...Number 57? No way, what a coincidence! That was my registration number before, too, wasn't it?"{w}
"...It's no coincidence.{w}I kept that number free for you."{w}
"Huh... you... you did...?"{w}
"I believed you'd come back for sure...{w}that the day would come when we'd be friends like this again... I believed it!"{w}
note: Row cut kept at the source's {w}.

en: "Miria...!"{w}
"Huh, what's this... all of a sudden...{w}...*sniff*... Geez!{w}It's because you... Miria... said such wei-- ...weird things..."{w}
note: [JP]…… stutter kept as 'wei--'.

en: "...Hey, Soara.{w}If you're going to help everyone from inside Bistel Castle,"{w}{p}"then I want to help everyone from outside the castle, from the Training Hall.{w}Can I... share the same dream as you, Soara?"{w}
"Of course... you... can... *hic*...{w}Miriaaaa..."{w}
"Welcome home, Soara!{w}You did so well, all on your own! You're amazing!!"{w}
"Th... thanks... I'm hooome..."{w}
{0E}      *  Soara Registered at the Training Hall  *{0F}{w}
note: Banner format copied from the slice 009 unlock banner.

en: {0E}      *  Free Portrait Selection Unlocked  *{0F}{w}
note: [JP] = free choice of face icon (portrait); no glossary term, check against the menu wording.

en: "If you want to go to Bistel Castle about the Decree, first register as an adventurer with me, then form a party at Berte's Tavern."{w}
"Sorry for being so rude earlier.{w}I've let the townspeople know that a new adventurer has arrived."{w}
note: [JP] = calling out to the player out of the blue (opening, row 2657).

en: "Have you finished registering as an adventurer yet?"{w}{p}"If you don't register, you can't be called at the tavern, and you can't have an audience with the Queen at the castle either."{w}
note: [JP]: an unregistered character cannot be called up to the party at the tavern.

en: "If you've got room to spare, maybe try training up some juniors."{w}{p}"Adventuring with one party is fine, but having a second party that can move will save you if you ever get stranded."{w}

"So, loads of people come and go at the Training Hall, and the little differences in how they speak and write are a real headache!"{w}{p}"The basics are the same everywhere, so it's not like I can't understand them at all... but every now and then there's some regional dialect or turn of phrase, you know?"{w}{p}"But magic users have to learn whole different languages, not just dialects, right?{w}That must be rough..."{w}
note: Source long-vowel [JP] (not the music note) not rendered as '~', since '~' stands for the note.

en: "Hey, have you ever been to Rubenburg? It's a magic school run by Isfald, a prestigious one that's turned out lots of court mages..."{w}{p}"A long time ago, I had a childhood friend here, a mage named Soara. She was really smart, and on top of her magical power, she worked harder than anyone."{w}{p}"We were close, but after I started working at the Training Hall and she got registered as an adventurer, things started getting tense between us. And in the end..."{w}
note: Soara is [JP] here (glossary: female).

en: "I'm serious!{w}I want to gain strength and knowledge as a mage and be useful to everyone!"{w}
note: Flashback starts here (Soara and Miria, years ago).

en:
"I know that...
I think it's admirable, okay? But..."{w}
"But what?"{w}

"That's what you want to do, Soara, isn't it?{w}There are all kinds of adventurers, right?"{w}{p}"There might be some with big ambitions like yours, but..."{w}{p}"Some people adventure as a hobby.{w}And of course, some just drift into it, and some do it grudgingly to make a living..."{w}{p}"Expecting everyone to put in as much effort as you do, Soara... I don't think that's quite right..."{w}
"So people who are actually serious about it have to get dragged down to match that lot?"{w}
"'That lot'...!?{w}Watch your mouth!!"{w}
"Nobody can get any better doing make-believe training like this!!"{w}
note: [JP] = playing house; kept as a put-down.

en: "That's a horrible thing to say!{w}Everyone's trying their best!!"{w}

"Hah!
'I tried my best' only cuts it in kindergarten."{w}
"...If you hate it that much, why don't you just get out of Bistel!?"{w}
"Wh-what did you say!?"{w}
"Go study at Rubenburg and become a great mage or whatever you like!"{w}

"Do you really mean that?
...You've got no intention of raising the standard of training here?"{w}

"That's asking the impossible!
This Training Hall doesn't exist just for you, Soara, you know?"{w}
